confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Guadalajara and Mexican urban pricing, not from inspected live listings. Restaurant, café and beer anchors are more reliable than hotel and hostel anchors, which vary more by neighbourhood and season. FX value taken from search-result summaries that cite the RBA exchange-rates page; the RBA table itself was not opened directly, so verify against table F11 before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against mid-sized Mexican urban centres outside Mexico City, with Guadalajara's tourist and business hotel market as the reference for accommodation.
